comparison.objective: Fit a funnel into a bottle and pour 24 beads through it from a jug.
comparison.physical_skill: Funnel insertion, jug pouring, stream control, and granular-object containment.
comparison.success_condition: All 24 beads enter the bottle; direct pours without the funnel score zero.
comparison.reason: Shared containment and small loose objects are generic. This record tests tool-assisted granular pouring, while the candidate creates fragments by calibrated impact and must preserve four installed coils before recovering each tang. No spec versions were provided.
